title: C05 Core: una costura MCP→preview→confirmación fixture→recibo nativo en PostgreSQL aislado

checks: only one actual native Core contract is composed
only the selected actual Core MCP preparer is advertised
the real Core preparer requests its required key without creating an action
MCP creates an exact ready Core preview while the domain is unchanged
identical MCP callback replay returns the same proposal without another draft or effect
the real native Core writer commits only the reviewed action preserving null and false
fixture confirmation crosses the actual exclusive Core frontier and stores one native receipt
duplicate fixture confirmation is one execution and one effect, not another action
original Core action history remains byte-equivalent after the single fixture effect
the real proof cleanup acknowledges the synthetic terminal once and duplicate cleanup is inert
the fixture ends with no pending job, open attempt or retained slot

negative_history_preserved.scope: Original bytes of failed harnessR01..R07 and their raw negative/diagnostic receipts, one archive only.
negative_history_preserved.R01: Execution output was lost before supervisor cleanup; outcome not reconstructed. Separate Root metadata proved owned PG/socket absent.
negative_history_preserved.R01_R02_cleanup_cause: Root control proved Docker missing-object text was lowercase; case-sensitive absence classification was a harness defect. Minimal HOME/context was not established as cause.
negative_history_preserved.R05_and_R07: Root/code readback establishes one ephemeral Core effect before the later harness assertion failed. A false status-derived boolean in old receipts is not proof of zero effects; original bytes remain unchanged.
negative_history_preserved.later_harness_fixes: Use actual worker confirmation queue and real CleanupUseCase/fixture ACK, preserve private errors before cleanup, measure effect count independently from overall status. No production runtime edit.

limits: Only one Core writer capability and the MCP preparation/confirmation seam are accepted here; native69/wire73 or all C05 families are not newly accepted.
Publication, provider transport/proofs and HTTP identity are synthetic fixtures; authorization, schemas, SQL/DI/Core exclusive lock, native writer and receipt are real compiled use cases.
No real Agentic account/MCP transport, human browser button/JWT authentication or live business mutation is tested.
The single action existed only in a disposable PostgreSQL database, removed with its owned container; configured DB and provider accounts were unused.
Independent NativeP1 adoption, UI/MIME/OCR, human/time/environment and global NodiaAI acceptance keep their own receipts/gates.
